title: Batch cost for restricted Fourier weight observations
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $S$ be a subset of $J$, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. The batch cost is the triple consisting of zero random-example oracle calls, $2m$ membership queries, and $m$ times $2$ plus the restricted-Fourier-weight observation work for $J$ and $S$ local computation steps.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The cost components are explicit, but the definition of restricted-Fourier-weight observation work is not included in the payload.
